name: xTool P3 80W
tagline: 2025 flagship 80W CO₂ : ACS automation, huge bed, optional IR for metal
tldr: xTool P3 (August 2025) replaces the P2/P2S as the company's CO₂ flagship: 80W tube, 915×458 mm bed, integrated chiller, fire suppression, and ACS™ automation (cameras, LiDAR autofocus, AI nesting). Optional 5W IR module adds bare-metal marking. From ~$5,999 : built for shops outgrowing diode lasers.
mainObjective: Automated 80W CO₂ production for sign shops and serious small businesses

priceRange.note: Standalone from ~$5,999; bundles with feeder, AutoLift, IR module extra

specs.dimensions: Large desktop footprint : plan dedicated space

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm acrylic

pros: Strong on acrylic and wood versus diodes on the same budget tier
Integrated cabinet helps contain the beam and everyday smoke versus open-frame diodes
Software listed on the profile : test your workflow (LightBurn or maker app) on scrap first
cons: Ventilation to the outside is mandatory for regular cutting, not an optional upgrade
Tube life and replacement cost are part of the true ownership budget
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 80W SKU on xTool P3. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other modules via the chips before buying.
proTips: Plan exhaust before delivery. Run material tests on the full bed : large beds need focus calibration at corners. Price the IR module only if metal is a regular revenue line.

editorialDepth.advantages: xTool P3 is built for acrylic signage, thick wood, and shop production once exhaust is sorted. 80W adds headroom on panels and multi-pass jobs.
editorialDepth.limitations: Avoid without ducting, for occasional gifts only, or if budget ignores tube replacement, power, and floor space. Bare metal without an IR accessory stays out of scope.

moduleSystem.headline: Optional 5W infrared (1064 nm) module
moduleSystem.description: Base machine is 80W CO₂. Add the IR module for bare-metal and plastic marking without a separate fiber engraver.
